parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that ensures request idempotence. The client generates this token. It must be unique across requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The name of the target instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.
